verdict.rationale: Quo documents a shared team number ("stay aligned with your team"), message and call history that can be filtered by contact, contact records, and call recordings that come back transcribed and summarized. Together these imply per-contact communication history across a team. There is no explicit documentation of calls and texts threading together under a contact record, of contact notes, or of team-wide visibility of that history. missing for 10: explicit unified call+text thread per contact, contact notes feature, documented team-shared visibility of contact history, independent/hands-on corroboration
